reasons: The cited clause (p0171) selects New York substantive law, which is within the accepted set, but is silent on forum; the finding correctly identifies the gap against the preferred position requiring exclusive jurisdiction of New York state and federal courts.

The redline is directionally correct and surgical in substance: the existing governing-law sentence is left verbatim and a single forum sentence is appended granting exclusive jurisdiction in New York County — exactly the playbook preferred forum.

The failed 'minimal edit' check is an artifact of the changed-character ratio counting the appended sentence; no existing wording was altered, so the edit is the smallest one that reaches the playbook position.

The comment is accurate (acknowledges NY law is acceptable, explains the forum addition and rationale), cites the playbook position, offers the Delaware/California/London fallback, and follows the required prefix and tone.

No arbitration seat exists, so the walk-away trigger is correctly ruled out; classifying this as a deviation (clause present but incomplete on forum) rather than wholly missing is defensible and does not affect the actionability of the proposal.
